newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX Natgas futures regain lead ahead of close.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX Natgas futures regain lead ahead of close.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natgas futures erased earlier losses Wednesday ahead of the close and release of American Gas Association storage data, propped up by firm cash and technical shortcovering, industry sources said.
At 1354 EDT, November was three cents higher at $2.215 per million British thermal units. Likewise, December regained 2.5 cents to $2.385, while other deferreds moved about one to three cents higher.
"They pushed it down too hard early. Locals got long," said one futures trader, noting shortcovering was pushing the contract higher late in light volume.
